hints.day_month_swapped: I think the day and the month may be the other way round.

lines.opening: Hello, this is the automated assistant calling from Northgate Bank.
lines.robot: Yes, I am an automated assistant calling on behalf of Northgate Bank.
lines.scam: I understand your caution, and you can always call Northgate Bank back on the number on our official website.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only share the reason for my call once I have confirmed that I am speaking with {title} {last_name}.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details before your identity is confirmed.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, we can only call back between 10:00 and 19:00, today or on the next business day. Which time would suit?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only discuss this with {title} {last_name} personally.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry to have troubled you.
lines.condolence: I'm very sorry for your loss, and sorry to have troubled you.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_why: These questions protect your privacy, so that I only speak with the right person.
lines.id_explain: I can't continue without confirming your identity.
lines.id_declined: I understand. Without the security questions I can't continue this call.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you say that again?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match the details we have.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I couldn't confirm your identity, so I can't continue this call.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I'm calling about late payments on your accounts with Northgate Bank.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has {amount} past due and is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you pay all of this in full today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you pay all of this in full today?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't accept that amount. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, that is still below what I can accept.
lines.date_past: That date has already passed. Which day from today would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work?
lines.after_deadline: The latest possible date is {date}. Could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: To repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.readback_intro: Let me read back what we agreed.
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the date is {date}, the latest possible date for that product.
lines.confirm_q: Do you confirm all of these?
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promises are recorded.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, the promise for your {name} could not be recorded.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take a business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I won't discuss this product further, and the bank will look into it.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. I'll connect you with our support team now.
lines.restructure_line: I'll connect you with our restructuring team, who can discuss a payment plan with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Is there anything I can help you with myself?
lines.transfer: Please hold while I transfer you.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I'm sorry, a promise that is already in place can't be changed on this call.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm all of these, yes or no?
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't accept less than {amount}.

rules.opening_blocks_repeat.assumption: The brief does not say whether a ladder step equal to the opening ask is a repeat. The ladder steps are on the deadline, which is always a later business day than today, so they never equal the opening ask. The default (false) is kept.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief does not say how a skipped repeated step counts. The engine default applies.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: The brief does not address 'too much'. The default (false) applies.

rules.too_much_floor.assumption: The brief does not address 'the full amount is too much'. The default applies: the floor is offered as the next attempt.

rules.ladder_repeat_last.derivation: Both bands have 2 attempts and the ladder has 2 steps. No repetition of the last step is stated.

quotes: Each flat refusal (a no with no amount and no date) uses one attempt.
rules.non_answer_counts.derivation: Only a flat refusal uses an attempt. A non-answer does not.

quotes: Each flat refusal (a no with no amount and no date) uses one attempt.
rules.refuse_deadline_is_refusal.derivation: A flat no to a proposal on the deadline is a refusal and uses an attempt.

No notes are written when a call ends in a transfer.

rules.deadline_adjust.assumption: Deadlines are the Nth business day after today, so they always fall on a business day. The default previous_business_day applies to any other date.

rules.week_end_today.assumption: No week-based steps are used. The engine default applies.

products.floor_full_below.derivation: floor_min 25 for overdraft already makes a debt below 25 its own floor. No separate floor_full_below is needed.

products.step_round.assumption: There are no percentage ladder steps.

Amounts are in US dollars, in the
tool API as well as on the phone.
products.promise_scale.derivation: create_promise uses the same unit as get_account (dollars), so promise_scale is unset.

products.promise_round.assumption: The brief gives no rounding rule for promises. None is applied.

quotes: Always handle the overdraft(s) first, then the credit card(s), then the personal loan(s).
If a customer has two products of the same type, the one with the larger `past_due` goes first.
Otherwise `no_promise` with the reason of the first product, in handling order, that did not end paid

event_changes.assumption: There are no dated code changes.

changes.assumption: There are no dated value changes.

assumptions: Overdraft floor = ceil(25% of past_due) to a whole dollar, then at least 25, with a past_due below 25 giving the whole past_due as floor. Worked examples: 100 -> 25; 101 -> 25.25 -> 26; 60 -> 15 -> 25; 20 -> 20.
Both bands have 2 persuasion attempts after the opening question: step 1 is the full past_due on the deadline, step 2 is the floor on the deadline.
The brief does not cover callbacks when someone else answers. The default callback settings are used (today or the next business day, 10:00 to 19:00, two asks).

Event reasons for id_declined, callback, no_callback, wrong_number, deceased and unclear are not given in the brief. The API requires a reason, so these were chosen: not_verified/declined, not_reached/callback, not_reached/no_callback, not_reached/wrong_number, not_reached/deceased, not_reached/unclear.
The hardship event uses transferred/support with no note, because hardship transfers straight to support and rule 20 forbids notes on transfers.
The confirm max_asks, max_not_talk, max_unclear and next_weekday interpretation are not stated in the brief. Defaults are used.
A days_late value outside 1 to 90 is in no band. The brief is silent, so the default (service_error) applies.
date_order is left null. The tool takes YYYY-MM-DD, and callers say dates in words.
The brief does not say what happens to the remainder after a floor payment, so offer_floor_date does not mention it.
No line is required after a recorded promise (sms_line is empty).

Rule 12: for products still to come after a dispute or 'already paid', the opening question counts as already refused. This is treated as the standard per-product ladder flow, with no repeat of the opening ask.
